fusions.name: Flattening Rear
fusions.desc: Rears and brings both forehooves down on an enemy at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with rank, dealing 24 damage and using up every affliction on it to add 1.2 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Anvil Gallop
fusions.desc: Gallops through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage, stunning everything in it for 1 second, with a 50% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Heavy Shoeing
fusions.desc: Increases your blunt damage by 30% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Farrier's Edge
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.
